21:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Monday Night Kickoff
The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

21:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Football
The Washington Commanders host the Cincinnati Bengals in NFL regular-season play at Northwest Stadium. Cincinnati arrives at 7-2 and winner of five straight, while Washington sits at 3-5-1 after alternating wins and losses over its last four games.
